palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed red body, dark source markings and face, pale chest/claws, and own eye colors without invented pupils or eyelids.
reference: Own DSTS chr090 model and native clips; PMDO registry supplies engine action names and event fields.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own biped stepping cycle, with per-frame foot contact and no duplicate endpoint.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native forward claw lunge; Physical Attack is never ground-trimmed.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own open-mouth/raised-claw special release; no projectile or effect asset invented.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own crouched resting clip; source eyes may remain open-looking, no painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native recoil with raised claws and mouth expression.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native broad arm/tail sweep with source body rotation.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two native claw-lunge cycles; engine XML exposes one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Own crouch-to-lift/recovery arc with fixed shadow; no artificial jump offset.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native braced/crouched preparation, reverse-sampled for recovery; no effect.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native stance/face gesture with whole-view yaw for Rotate; no duplicate endpoint.
